violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Ranch (62) was not temping properly in the 1DR prep top unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC THREW RANCH AWAY AND MOVED OTHER CONDIMENTS TO 1DR UPR COOLER TO COOL BACK TO 41.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1DR prep top unit was not working properly and was temping at 55F at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL EQUIPMENT SHOULD BE WORKING AT A MAXIMUM TEMP OF 41 DEGREES. PIC WILL PUT IN A SERVICE REQUEST FOR EQUIPMENT TODAY IN ORDER TO GET FIXED.
